Severe Weather Warning for South West, Central, West and South Gippsland, East Gippsland
warnings.desc: HEAVY RAINFALL which may lead to FLASH FLOODING is forecast during the remainder of Saturday and into early Sunday. For GEELONG and the OTWAYS: 6-hourly rainfall totals between 35 and 55 mm are likely. Isolated falls up to 70 mm are possible, most likely about the elevated parts. 24-hourly totals between 60 and 90 mm are likely, with isolated falls up to 150 mm possible about elevated parts of the Otways. Conditions are easing and expected to clear off in the early evening. For GIPPSLAND: 6-hour

warnings.title: Severe Thunderstorm Warning for Hunter, Central Tablelands, Southern Tablelands, South West Slopes, Australian Capital Territory
warnings.desc: Severe thunderstorms are likely to produce damaging winds, large hailstones and heavy rainfall that may lead to flash flooding in the warning area over the next several hours. Locations which may be affected include Canberra, Kandos, Glen Davis, Capertee, Hill End and Queanbeyan. Severe thunderstorms are no longer occurring in the Metropolitan and Central West Slopes and Plains districts and the warning for these districts is CANCELLED.

warnings.desc: The Bureau of Meteorology warns that, at 6:10 pm, a severe thunderstorm likely to produce damaging winds, large hailstones and heavy rainfall that may lead to flash flooding was detected. The thunderstorm is moving towards the east. It is forecast to affect Belconnen, Hall and Gungahlin by 6:40 pm.
